# engineering-standards

> The shared contract, gates, and workflows every WyattAu Omni repo derives from.

Every WyattAu estate repo runs its CI from this repository's shared workflow
kits and checks its own drift against `estate.yml`, the registry of record.

## Read first

- [README](https://github.com/WyattAu/engineering-standards/blob/main/README.md): what this repo is for
- [OMNI-CORE](https://github.com/WyattAu/engineering-standards/blob/main/OMNI-CORE.md): the family-wide contract templates implement
- [LOOP](https://github.com/WyattAu/engineering-standards/blob/main/LOOP.md): iteration log, doctrine, and the current contract
- [PITFALLS](https://github.com/WyattAu/engineering-standards/blob/main/PITFALLS.md): lessons that must not be relearned
- [COMPETITIVE-ANALYSIS](https://github.com/WyattAu/engineering-standards/blob/main/COMPETITIVE-ANALYSIS.md): market matrix vs leading templates
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/WyattAu/engineering-standards/blob/main/AGENTS.md): instructions for AI coding agents

## Machine-readable

- [estate.yml](https://github.com/WyattAu/engineering-standards/blob/main/estate.yml): every repo, its area, status, and gate scope
- [scripts](https://github.com/WyattAu/engineering-standards/tree/main/scripts): canonical gate implementations and their self-tests

## Shared workflows

Templates consume these by pinned SHA (`tier`-based quality kits):
`rust-kit.yml`, `go-kit.yml`, `haskell-kit.yml`, `python-kit.yml`, `node-ci.yml`.

## Decisions

- [ADRs](https://github.com/WyattAu/engineering-standards/tree/main/docs/adr): including superseded ones, kept verbatim
- [ADR-0001 copier](https://github.com/WyattAu/engineering-standards/blob/main/docs/adr/0001-copier-based-derived-repo-updates.md): derived-repo updates
